prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet lives on your desktop screen. Click to summon, right-click for quick actions, or drag to re-position anytime.", "Interaction Guide"]
1: ["Review Your Companion Render", "Here is how your companion will appear on your desktop. Confirm if everything looks great!", "Render Preview", "Looks Great"]
2: ["Sign in with your primary account to keep all adopted pets safely synced to this device.", "Connecting your existing account restores all saved companions and custom pet settings automatically."]
3: ["Initializing Desktop Companion Environment", "Preparing screen overlay and graphics drivers for seamless desktop pet rendering.", "Preparing Desktop Overlay", "Desktop Tips"]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Companion", "Select whether to pick from existing species or create a one-of-a-kind custom pet.", "Path Teaser"]
5: ["Make It Official", "Sign the official adoption record to bring your companion home to your desktop screen.", "Official Stamp Animation"]
6: ["Testing Desktop Display Layer", "We are verifying your display settings to make sure your pet floats smoothly over your windows.", "Screen Overlay Test", "Pet Is Visible!"]
7: ["Don't worry! You can add more companions or switch styles anytime after setup.", "Path Guidance"]
8: ["If the sign-in popup does not open automatically, click below to refresh authentication.", "Secure Authentication System Active"]
9: ["Verifying System Compatibility", "Checking system permissions to make sure your companion can move freely around your desktop.", "System Requirements", "Continue to Desktop"]
